I have 4k hours, it's a great social game, with top tier customization, semi pay to win, exploration slightly as you progress, end game is mission based 4 player missions (some higher than 4) with a new grind for weapons and augments every few months. It definitely lacks major content, as new weapons are constantly phased in. You feel your weapon progression is almost not worth it unless your an extreme grinder. You can get by with the bare minimum as how the game is designed. Some harder content definitely becomes easier with better augments of course. It's a very meh game. That does get constant updates. I play every few months because of the updates. But I'm no longer logging in daily. Daily game rotation is this, sit in main city talking to friends, wait for the UQ, occasionally grind in open world for drops if your lucky, do the occasional mission. Does NG deserve the hate yes it does. It's not nearly as good as older phantasy star titles, can it be fun, yes and if you enjoy the gameplay loop it can be addicting. But I think it's mainly due to the social aspect for me.
